title: 第11章 引气入体
novel_title: 伪装隐世仙族后，大佬疯狂跪舔我
content_zh:
“恭喜宿主装逼值累积已达9000，奖励装逼成长礼包一份。”

    微生璃月看着系统背包里整整齐齐的九份成长礼包，心里美滋滋。

    她还以为只有靠完成指定任务才能获得系统奖励，或者通过装逼值在系统商城里兑换，没想到统子还给她准备了装逼成长礼包。

    这样的话，那她就不客气了。

    “统子，打开所有成长礼包。”

    对于这种额外获得的未知礼物，最是具有神秘感和吸引力。

    而且经过新手礼包爆出来那些好东西后，微生璃月相信这些礼包里的东西肯定不会差。

    “好的阿璃，正在帮你打开成长礼包。”

    “叮叮叮，宿主气运逆天，恭喜宿主获得神兽蛋（需孵化）×3，极品灵石100万×2，极品洗灵草×1，天阶八品瞬移符×1，护身傀儡升级丹×1，谢谢惠顾×1。”

    看到前面礼包爆出来的东西，微生璃月都很喜欢，神兽蛋，极品灵石，这下她是真暴富了。

    不过……后面这个谢谢惠顾是什么鬼？成长礼包里面竟然还有这种选项。

    “统子，这个谢谢惠顾以后也会出现在成长礼包里面？”

    要是这种礼包的概率增多，那岂不是说抽到它就会浪费自己一个成长礼包？

    “是滴阿璃，不过阿璃你不用担心，成长礼包开出谢谢惠顾的概率是百分之五十，阿璃第一次开就只开出一个，其他全是好东西，可以说气运逆天了。”装逼系统解释道。

    像神兽蛋这么难得的东西，光是开出一个都已经是万分之一的概率，而它家阿璃一次性开出三个，这不是气运逆天是什么。

    “是这样吗？”

    微生璃月有点不敢相信，她的运气会这么好。
content_en:
"Congratulations to the host for reaching 9,000 pretentious points. You will be rewarded with a pretentious growth gift pack."

Weisheng Liyue looked at the neat Jiufen growth gift packs in the system backpack and felt happy.

She thought that she could only obtain system rewards by completing designated tasks, or redeem them in the system mall through pretentious points. Unexpectedly, Tongzi also prepared a pretentious growth gift package for her.

In this case, she would be rude.

"Tongzi, open all the growth gift packages."

This extra unknown gift is most mysterious and attractive.

And after seeing the good stuff revealed in the novice gift packs, Weisheng Liyue believed that the items in these gift packs would definitely be good.

"Okay Ali, I'm helping you open the growth gift package."

"Ding ding ding, the host has unlucky luck. Congratulations to the host for obtaining 3 mythical beast eggs (need to be hatched), 1 million of the best spiritual stones, 2, the best spiritual cleansing grass, 1, the eighth-level teleportation talisman of the heavenly level, 1, and the protective puppet upgrade pill, 1. Thank you for your patronage, 1."

Weisheng Liyue liked the things that came out of the previous gift pack, including mythical beast eggs and top-quality spiritual stones. Now she was really rich.

But... what the hell is this thank you for your patronage?There is actually such an option in the growth gift package.

"Tongzi, this thank you for your patronage will also appear in the growth gift package in the future?"

If the probability of this kind of gift package increases, doesn't it mean that if you draw it, you will waste a growth gift package?

"It's Ali, but Ali, don't worry. The probability of getting a growth gift pack to thank you for your patronage is 50%. Ali only got one for the first time. The others are all good things. It can be said that you are lucky." The pretentious system explained.

For something as rare as a mythical beast egg, the probability of getting one is already one in ten thousand. But his Ali got three of them at once. This is not just bad luck.

"Is that so?"

Weisheng Liyue couldn't believe that she was so lucky.
title_en: Chapter 11 Introducing Qi into the Body
